positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, developed, tested, and maintained .NET core micro-services for Trip Management API and Angular UI components for various mapping web apps (Routereporter, MapSure, MapExact, Fleet InSite)
positions.insights: .NET Core, Microsoft SQL Server and +10 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Researched AWS SageMaker to improve ML training data workflow

Developed UI and configured corresponding server-less infrastructure in AWS to capture and store user-inputted segmentation data. 

Wrote documentation and trained end users on the use of the developed segmentation tool. 

Developed an internal dashboard to display metrics such as how much training data is gathered per day and the quality of training data.

positions.title: Tutor (Web Development)
positions.description:
Responsible for tutoring students within their respective web development accreditation programs of their university in a one-on-one setting. 

Support students by reinforcing web development fundamentals, particularly the MERN stack.
